verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas's cloud Editor auto-saves projects to its cloud, so data residency is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence documents any region or residency choice for stored project data. 'Download Apps for Self-hosting' covers hosting built apps, which is an adjacent feature. Using the open-source engine locally is a user-side workaround, not a residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
